faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subhead: Everything you need to know before starting a project.

q1.a: We begin with a free consultation to understand your business goal, then deliver a technical proposal with pricing and timeline within 2–3 days. Once the contract is signed, the team starts work and shows weekly demos.

q2.q: How do I track project progress?
q2.a: Every client gets a dedicated project manager. Through weekly demo calls, a Telegram group and a task board, you see every stage of the project in real time.

q3.q: I'm not technical — is that a problem?
q3.a: Not at all. We explain technical details in plain language and take full ownership of engineering decisions. All we need from you is a clearly stated business goal.

q4.q: Do you work with small businesses?
q4.a: Absolutely. Our portfolio includes small businesses and startups alongside large enterprises. We build a phased plan that fits your budget — core features first, expansion later.

q5.q: How do contracts and warranty work?
q5.a: All projects run under an official contract that clearly defines scope, timeline, price and confidentiality terms. Delivered work is covered by a 12-month technical warranty.

q1.q: How much does a project cost?
q1.a: Pricing depends on complexity: landing and business card sites are the most affordable, corporate websites are mid-range, and CRM/ERP or mobile apps are quoted individually. We provide an exact quote within 2–3 days of a free consultation.

q2.a: Usually in stages: an advance at the start, the rest as milestones are delivered. For large projects a monthly payment schedule is possible. All payments are fixed in the contract.

q3.a: A landing page takes 1–2 weeks, a corporate website 3–5 weeks, an online store 4–8 weeks, and CRM/ERP systems 2–4 months. The exact timeline is set after the specification is agreed and fixed in the contract.

q4.a: No — the price agreed in the contract is final. Only the domain, hosting and third-party services (such as an SMS provider) are billed separately, and we state these upfront.

q5.q: Why are you more expensive than some agencies?
q5.a: We build an engineered product, not a template: clean code, documented architecture, SEO and scalability are included in the price. This saves significant rebuild costs down the road.

q1.a: Our core stack is Next.js, React, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL and MongoDB. We use AWS and other platforms for cloud infrastructure, and OpenAI technologies for AI solutions.

q2.q: Do you guarantee site speed and SEO?
q2.a: Yes. Every project is built to Core Web Vitals standards: fast loading, semantic HTML, schema.org markup and a sitemap are configured from day one. That's the technical foundation for strong Google rankings.

q3.a: Technical support is free for 12 months: bug fixes, security updates and monitoring. After that, you can optionally continue with a monthly maintenance contract.

q4.q: Who owns the code and the system?
q4.a: You do, fully. After project delivery, all source code, design files and accounts are transferred to your name. No hidden dependencies remain.

q5.q: Can you integrate with our existing systems?
q5.a: Yes. We have extensive experience integrating with 1C, AmoCRM, Bitrix24, payment systems (Payme, Click, Stripe), SMS gateways and other APIs. We also help migrate data from legacy systems.
